blocks.alt: Oopar baen taraf peeli makai ke bhutte (corn cobs), beech aur daen taraf safed popcorn ka dher, aur aage makai ke peele daane (kernels), grey-beige bori (sacking) par.
blocks.caption: Figure 13.3 (kitab ki Figure 13.3 wali tasveer ke mutabiq original drawing)

blocks.text: Popcorn aur gaari ke tyre ka pressure is ki misalein hain. Jab makai ka dana (popcorn kernel) garam hota hai to us ke andar band moisture (nami) steam (bhaap) ban jati hai. Daane ke andar pressure barhta hai, chhilka phat jata hai aur andar ka gelatinous (jelly jaisa) starch bahar aa jata hai, jo thanda ho kar sakht ho jata hai. (Kitab ki Fig 13.3 popcorn ki tasveer hai.)

Jab gaari ke tyre mein hawa bharte hain to andar hawa ke molecules ki number barhti hai aur pressure barhta hai. Volume limited (mehdood) hai, is liye zyada molecules tyre ki deewaron se zyada baar takrate hain. Yahi pressure tyre ko sakht rakhta hai aur pichke baghair gaari ka weight (wazan) uthata hai.

blocks.prompt: Agar gas ka absolute temperature double kar diya jaye to rms speed kitne guna hoti hai?
blocks.explanation: vᵣₘₛ = √(3k_BT/m), yani vᵣₘₛ ∝ √T. T double karne se vᵣₘₛ √2 ≈ 1.41 guna ho jati hai.

blocks.prompt: Ek hi kamre mein oxygen aur nitrogen ke molecules ki average kinetic energy barabar hai? Kya rms speed bhi barabar hai?
blocks.explanation: Average kinetic energy barabar hai, (3/2)k_BT, kyunke yeh sirf temperature par depend karti hai. rms speed barabar nahi: halke N₂ molecules tez chalte hain (25 °C par N₂ 515 m s⁻¹, O₂ taqreeban 481 m s⁻¹, Example 13.2).

rows: O₂ aur N₂ dono ki barabar: (3/2)k_BT
Sirf temperature par depend karti hai
Temperature aur molecule ke mass dono par depend karti hai
Halka N₂ tez (515 m s⁻¹), bhari O₂ dheema (481 m s⁻¹)

items: <K.E._T> = ½mv²ᵣₘₛ = (3/2)k_BT (13.18): temperature average K.E. ka measure (naap) hai.
Misalein: popcorn ka phatna, tyre mein hawa ka pressure.
